Name: Split Screen Regions
Author: FearGodFishFish
Description:
[img]https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Smoked-Fish/AnythingAnywhere/main/images/installation.png[/img]
[list]
[*]Install the latest version of [url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url]
[*]Download this mod and unzip it into [b][code]Stardew Valley/Mods[/code][/b]
[*]Run the game using SMAPI.
[/list][img]https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Smoked-Fish/AnythingAnywhere/main/images/how-to-use.png[/img]
Open the mod config in [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] and select the mode you want to edit. They will update live so its easier to get them in the position you want.

A couple things to note:
[list]
[*] The main player will not have their viewport updated live unless toggled on. To update the main player, click save, then move one of the sliders to force an update
[*] When you click the reset button, the sliders will stay at the value they were before but the viewports will get reset. The sliders will update when you leave the menu or move them
[/list][img]https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Smoked-Fish/AnythingAnywhere/main/images/my-other-mods.png[/img]
[list]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/21233]Build and Place Anything Anywhere[/url]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/23488]Precise Furniture[/url]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/23544]Particle Framework[/url]
[/list]
